authority.name: National Highway grievance coordination (verify maintaining agency)

limitations: Coverage follows operational NH/NE references mapped in OpenStreetMap and is not a legal road-ownership register.
The maintaining agency is deliberately not inferred from geometry; the user must verify it in the official service.
Proposed, construction-only, service, residential, path, track and other non-carriageway classes are excluded.
source.source_filter: ways with ref=NH*, ref=NE*, or network=IN:NH; operational drivable classes
